svg.title: Salamandra CLEAN and V1a side elevations
svg.desc: Metric A3 side-elevation draft comparing SALAMANDRA-CLEAN with the V1a passive twin-fin variant. The two CORE-rooted fins and their aft root supports remain forward of the fixed propeller hazard; their side projections coincide. No movable rudder is defined.
